description: Who can open the app when Apprua is on the local network or the internet: "private" (only the owner and the administrators), "team" (anyone with an Apprua account, the default) or "public" (anyone, no sign-in: only for apps meant for everybody). Applies at once. Ask the user before making an app public.

name.description: App name = sub-domain, e.g. "my-notes" (lowercase letters, digits, dashes)

name: set_visibility
title: Choose who can open the app
